about: Captured by running the PRE-CHANGE pr-automation.yml (4e9adf18 + #241) gate script and paid-review jq program. Frozen: never regenerate from a later template, or the golden stops meaning 'today's behaviour'.
jq_program:
. + {head_sha:$head_sha} |
  .pass = (
    .complete == true and .accurate == true and
    .human_readable == true and
    .opening_accessible == true and
    .opening_bluf == true and
    .audience_order == true and
    .architecture_diagram_complete == true and
    .all_capabilities_documented == true and
    .all_commands_documented == true and
    .all_configuration_documented == true and
    .examples_sufficient == true and
    .onboarding_sufficient == true and
    .operations_sufficient == true and
    .security_sufficient == true and
    .release_process_sufficient == true and
    .links_valid == true and
    ((.findings // []) | length == 0)
  )
